subject: Corporation-Agent

scope.evidenceBasis: Only the final user-visible TXT and PNG files listed by the manifest were used.

verdictBasis: Most evidence boundaries are honest and readable, but one default top-five Story connects a report-change claim to an unrelated collaboration script as its only related concrete change. Several other default Stories describe artifact operations without enough content-level specificity for a first-time user to understand the material result.

dimensions.name: project_identity
dimensions.reason: The project name, enterprise Agent Workspace purpose, identity/role/permission scope and v2.2.0 description are visible at the top. The page marks this as a README declaration rather than a verified runtime result.

dimensions.name: current_confirmable_results
dimensions.reason: The page limits confirmed results to observed material such as PostgreSQL sample configuration, matching version records and clean worktree state, and separately lists twelve unknowns. It does not establish runtime feature success.

dimensions.name: recent_material_changes
dimensions.reason: The notification/communication/attachment Story is materially specific, but most of the other default top-five Stories only say documents, version records, instructions or reports changed. Their details usually repeat file-change semantics rather than tell the first-time user what content changed.

dimensions.name: story_and_evidence_traceability
dimensions.reason: Story 5 names version 2.0.0 and 2.1.0 reports, but its only related concrete-change route resolves to scripts/browser_collaboration.mjs and does not explain the relationship. Direct Git evidence exists elsewhere, so the two user paths disagree rather than forming one coherent trace.

dimensions.name: claim_inference_unknown_boundary
dimensions.reason: README claims, system summaries, observed Git records and unknowns are visibly labeled. Each Story repeatedly states that a file change does not prove runtime behavior or acceptance.

dimensions.name: single_branch_presentation
dimensions.reason: Only main is shown. The view distinguishes local observation from absent GitHub data, keeps PR state unknown, and explains that ahead/behind counts compare commits and do not prove work was merged.

dimensions.name: time_meaning
dimensions.reason: Changes are labeled with commit time, workline data with local observation time, and remote time as unknown. The four inferred Chapters overlap heavily across a five-day window; the UI admits dates may overlap, but the boundaries remain broad rather than explaining distinct phases.

dimensions.name: unsupported_or_overstrong_conclusions
dimensions.reason: Even when original commit messages say acceptance completed or CI passed, the system-facing summary only asserts observed file changes and explicitly withholds runtime or acceptance conclusions.

dimensions.name: story_chapter_thread_repetition_and_specificity
dimensions.reason: The long-term Threads are correctly absent without continuity. Story 3 does not show the actual version transition, Story 4 does not say which usage guidance changed, and overlapping Chapter labels remain category bundles rather than clearly differentiated stages.

dimensions.name: responsive_readability
dimensions.reason: The project identity, evidence-boundary language, recent-change cards and workline unknown state remain readable from 390 through 1600 pixels without observed horizontal clipping.

findings.title: Story 5 的主变化与唯一关联范围不一致
findings.observed: 主 Story 说修改了 2.0.0、2.1.0 项目报告，但关联的具体变化只有修改项目材料，其范围和逐文件来源都只指向 scripts/browser_collaboration.mjs。
findings.impact: 首次用户沿主 Story 的推荐下钻路径会从报告变更跳到协作脚本，无法确认两者为何属于同一结果，且容易把无关文件当成报告变化的直接依据。
findings.revisionCriterion: 让关联范围直接列出并对应报告文件，或明确解释协作脚本与报告 Story 的证据关系；主 Story、关联范围和逐文件来源应形成同一条可读证据链。

findings.title: 多数默认 Story 仍停留在文件操作层
findings.observed: 默认前五条中，Story 1 只说新增和修改项目文档，Story 3 只说版本记录新增和修改，Story 4 只说使用说明新增和修改；对应的本次变化和当前结果主要复述这些文件动作。Story 3 未给出版本从何值变为何值，Story 4 未说明哪项使用方法改变。
findings.impact: 用户可以确认文件发生变化，却难以从 Story 层理解最近形成了什么具体项目结果；默认列表的信息密度仍受文档、版本文件和报告记录主导。
findings.revisionCriterion: 在来源允许时，用内容级事实说明具体改变；来源不支持内容级判断时，明确标为仅文件记录，并避免让多条同类文件操作占据主要 Story 位置。

findings.title: 证据详情暴露内部枚举和原始覆盖 JSON
findings.observed: 详情直接显示 OBSERVED、SOURCE_BACKED、GIT_COMMIT_TIME 以及 coverage JSON。
findings.impact: 这些字段能辅助审计，但首次用户需要翻译内部协议后才能理解来源身份和时间依据，降低证据层可读性。
findings.revisionCriterion: 保留机器字段的可选展开，同时在默认详情中给出中文人话标签。

findings.title: 时间篇章边界可见但区分度有限
findings.observed: 四个系统归纳篇章覆盖 2026-09-05 至 2026-09-09，其中前三个范围依次为 9/5–9/9、9/6–9/9、9/8–9/9，主题以报告/对话/工作区、历程/证据/模型配置、协作/通知/证据等宽泛类别打包。页面已说明日期可以重叠。
findings.impact: 时间事实本身清楚，但用户不易理解这些高度重叠的篇章为何是不同阶段。
findings.revisionCriterion: 为每个篇章显示形成边界的关键变化或明确其只是重叠主题窗口，而非线性阶段。

uncoveredDimensions: The frozen inputs do not show link, button, search, close, back-navigation or keyboard interaction outcomes.
Only page 1 of 4 is visible for the Story 2 related-file pagination; pages 2–4 were not part of the manifest.
GitHub and PR data are explicitly unconfigured, so remote branch and review semantics cannot be assessed.
No accessibility tree, screen-reader output, focus order or contrast measurements were supplied.
This semantic review does not verify the Corporation-Agent application's runtime features or the truth of commit-message claims beyond how the ProjectFlow UI bounds them.
